findings.text: Upheld (Q4, Q6). spawnMirror launches `serve mirror --data <dir>`, but the mirror subcommand only parses `{ rebuild: "flag" }` (src/cli/commands/serve.ts:479), so `--data` is an unknown flag, the child exits with the usage code, and the real export never runs from a live server. The subcommands also take their directory only from resolveTeamDir(process.env) (serve.ts:574), which contradicts the USAGE line at serve.ts:64. Checked against the code.

Upheld (Q4, dead path). Line 566 already sends every argument starting with `--` to runServer. parseFlags then rejects `--help` as an unknown flag, so the `sub === "--help"` half of line 567 is never reached and `serve --help` exits with the usage error. Only `-h` reaches the branch. Checked against the code.

Upheld (Q4, a parameter nobody uses). Nothing in src/team reads `options.env` (line 46) or `options.gitPath` (line 49), but serve.ts passes `env`. Checked by searching for `options.env` and `options.gitPath`.

Upheld (Q2, logic duplicated). The `<device id>:<uid>` key-grammar split is written three times with the same body: push.ts:423 splitMemoryKey, feed.ts:85 splitKey and mirror.ts:530 splitKey. This is a domain rule, not boilerplate, and a change to the key grammar would have to be made in three places.

Lowered to advisory. The repeated piece is one expression, `clip(redact(message.replace(/\s+/g, " ")), MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS, "…")`, and it already calls the shared clip, redact and MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS. The redaction policy lives in one place, so this is duplicated boilerplate rather than duplicated logic (Q2 advisory).

Lowered to advisory. Both edges call the one mintInvitation. What repeats is how each edge maps its own input (a request body, CLI flags) onto that call, plus the audit detail string. That is adapter boilerplate, not duplicated logic (Q2 advisory). The disable audit detail at routes.ts:440 against serve.ts:387 is the same case.
Advisory, as filed (Q2, boilerplate): the `operator`/`cli` literals sit beside push.ts's OPERATOR and feed.ts defines its own OPERATOR.
Advisory, as filed (Q2/Q3): hex16 and instance.ts:53 duplicate newHexId in ids.ts.
Advisory, as filed (Q5): readBody goes through a synthetic Request and then reparses the returned problem Response.
Advisory, as filed (Q8, unused export): ChangeSignal.waiting() has no caller.
Advisory, as filed (Q8, unused export): JoinRefusal is imported nowhere.
Advisory, as filed (Q8, unused export): migrateFile and migrateModules are exported, but only db.ts calls them.
Advisory, as filed (Q5): this re-export exists only so a test can import from feed.ts.
Advisory, as filed (Q2/Q4): teamPaths().backups is read by nobody and repeats teamBackups(dir).folder.
Advisory, as filed (Q5): audit() only forwards to insertAudit. The narrower AuditSource type is the value it adds.
Advisory, as filed (Q6, style): lines over the formatter's width at db.ts:352, db.ts:77 and src/modules/knowledge/repo.ts:478.
Advisory, debt outside the change. The sharing-policy bullet still says the team server "does not exist yet". The diff did not write that line.

Upheld (Q1). AC-47 promises that a retry is `applied` with revision 1 while the item is locked by an admin. The test withdraws and reinstates (lines 212-227) without sending a retry while the lock holds, so reordering the idempotency check after the lock check would leave the test green. Checked against the test.

Upheld (Q1). AC-57 says the contract test "fails when they change without CONTRACT". The test compares contractFingerprint() with CONTRACT_FINGERPRINT, a constant in src/team/contract.ts, and asserts only that CONTRACT is 1. Repinning that constant without bumping CONTRACT passes. The pair CONTRACT → fingerprint is not pinned in the test. Checked against the test.

Upheld (Q1). AC-49 promises a lease renewal "before every git call". The assertion is `reads > 3` on the clock plus the stolen-lease abort, which would also pass with one renewal per commit or per repository.

Upheld (Q1). AC-49 promises that the server runs `serve mirror` as a child and forwards its lines to the log. Every test injects mirrorChild, so neither spawnMirror nor forwardLine (src/team/mirror.ts:615-644) runs in any test. The real child is in fact broken (code-quality, risk and architecture F-1, mirror.ts:626) and no test fails.

Upheld (Q1). AC-51 says the logs never contain a code after the bootstrap line, or a payload. The test checks only that the token is absent, in a run that pushes nothing, so leaking a code or a payload into the log would fail no test.

Upheld (Q1). AC-51 says that `serve` and `serve health` skip the legacy migration. Only `serve health` is checked against the seeded legacy home (lines 235-246). The `serve` started at line 258 with that home asserts only exit 3 and nothing about the legacy folder, so `serve` itself is not proven to skip the migration. Checked against the test.
Upheld (Q1). AC-51 says a server that loses its lease "exits 1 after answering its held pulls". No pull is held when the renewal fails, so the held-pulls half of the clause is untested.

Upheld (Q1). AC-45 says the token is "nowhere in the database". The test reads only group_concat(token_hash) FROM devices (line 95), so a token written to audit, meta, a label or an invitation row would pass. Checked against the test.

Lowered to advisory. AC-54 as written covers the image build, a container run and a stop on Docker, none of which has a red run, and its recorded reason (evidence.json) describes that run truthfully. So the reason holds for what makes the criterion observed. The file half could have been a behaviour criterion with its own red. The lead states a red was run and the engine refused to record it for an observed criterion. It is not in the item's record, so this is not ruled as proven, but the observed reason is not false. Splitting the file half into a behaviour criterion would have closed the gap.
Advisory, as filed. Reopening the file does not show that the handle was closed.
Advisory, as filed. The 200 MiB storage floor is tested only at 100 MiB, so the boundary is not pinned.
Advisory, as filed. The test does not show that a retry leaves the bucket's level unchanged.
Advisory, as filed. Only part of the admin routes are tried as a member for the 403.
Advisory, as filed. The test uses `--limit 2` where AC-52 names 5. The feed.seq and audit-row counts are checked for `invite` only.
Advisory, as filed. The `latest` regex does not require the negation.
Advisory, as filed (Q2). The test asserts the helper's own newUuid output. The rest of the alias test does not rest on that line.
Advisory, as filed. importsOf misses dynamic import() and require.
Advisory, as filed. No assertion on the hooks path or signing in the recorded git arguments.
Advisory, as filed. "No request waits on git" is timed with a no-op mirrorChild.

Upheld (Q3, auth: a credential not revoked where the permission it vouches for changes). setRole demotes without calling revokeInvitationsOfDevice, while revokeDevice (line 291) and disableMember (line 304) both do. A demoted admin who holds an unused `role: admin` invitation they minted can join with it and obtain a new admin member and token. That is an under-authorised path to admin. Checked against the code.
Advisory, as filed. The rubric treats a limit where none existed as hardening. Bad-token requests are not rate-limited, and the tokens carry 256 bits.
Advisory, as filed. The memory uid has no grammar or length check beyond the item cap.
Advisory, as filed. Upgrade copies keep purged items until they are rotated out. This is latent at team schema 1, where no upgrade copy exists.
Advisory, as filed. Concurrent held pulls per device are not bounded.

Upheld (Q1, a failure nobody would see in the first hour). The child is launched with `--data`, which `serve mirror` rejects, so the export never runs in production. meta.mirror.last is never written, `serve status` shows no run and no error while the pending count grows, and the only trace is a `mirror-exit` warn line that nothing alerts on. Checked against the code.

Upheld (Q1/Q3). purgeItem commits the erasure transaction and only then calls replayFolders, which takes mirror.lease (line 376) and throws while a mirror run holds it. The CLI then exits without the audit row of serve.ts:510, the list of folders to rebuild is lost, the text stays in the mirror's history, and a second purge answers unknown. An irreversible deletion ends with no record and a message that says it failed. Checked against the code.
Advisory, as filed. publish now depends on a docker job that CI never runs. The failure would be visible as a red job, and re-running it or editing `needs` undoes it.
Advisory, as filed. openTeamDb migrates before the serve lease is checked. This cannot bite at team schema 1 but will at the first schema bump.
Advisory, as filed. The version 0.7.0 is ahead of package.json, which is at 0.6.0. A wrong tag would be visible at `docker compose pull`.
Advisory (Q2). The rollback across a schema bump is manual but stated in the spec and in ADR 0026. The rubric calls a rollback that exists but is manual advisory.
Advisory. The spec states that the HEALTHCHECK has no consumer, so this is a flag that would have made the first hour safer, not a hidden failure.

Upheld (Q3/Q5). The Design (D-26) has the server run `serve mirror` as its own child process, given its data directory. The server builds that call with `--data`, but the subcommand neither parses `--data` (src/cli/commands/serve.ts:479) nor reads it at all (serve.ts:574 uses resolveTeamDir(process.env) only). The contract between the server and its child is built differently on the two sides, and the Design's export never runs. Checked against the code.
Advisory, as filed. db.ts keeps runtime reads beyond the three opens the ADR's boundary sentence describes.
Advisory, as filed. The domain modules import Context, Limits and Meta from the route layer. This is a dependency-direction disagreement inside src/team, where the base is silent.
Advisory, as filed. The mirror's git failures are logged under the `knowledge.mirror` scope.
Advisory, as filed. migrateFile and migrateModules are exported with no outside consumer.
Advisory, debt outside the change. The sharing-policy wording that the server "does not exist yet" sits in a line the diff did not write.

Upheld (Q5, erasure as the project states it, D-24). The erasure transaction commits before replayFolders takes mirror.lease. When the lease is held the replay throws, the purged text stays in the repos/ git history, nothing durable records that a replay is owed, and a second purge answers unknown. A mirror child that loaded the revisions before the purge can also commit them afterwards. Checked against the code (lines 552-608, 376).

Upheld (Q5, personal data in a new column without its retention). audit.address stores the source IP of joins, failed joins included. The spec (line 161, line 340) names the column and the table's growth, but neither the spec nor ADR 0026 states a retention or an erasure path for it, and no prune or purge reaches the audit table.
Advisory, as filed (Q3). The purged audit row is written outside the erasure transaction. Its consequence is upheld above under mirror.ts:605.
Advisory, as filed. markPurged's OR plus substr defeats changes_key on an admin-rare path, and an index is present that a range would use.
Advisory, as filed. A move tombstone's `@` key can collide with another memory key on the same device. Only the device's own items are exposed.

Advisory, as filed. The page and payload reads are not in one snapshot. The per-row lookups are primary-key reads bounded by the page size, and the rubric's N+1 defect is about an ORM that would load relations once, which does not apply to this raw-SQL store.
Advisory, as filed. The aliases in the UNION ALL are not deduplicated or capped.
Advisory, as filed. workspaceEntriesOf scans the entries table on a rare admin act, not a list path.
Advisory, as filed. allRevisions loads the whole history at once.
Advisory, as filed. --rebuild removes repos/ and resets mirror_revision in separate steps, so a crash between them is not atomic.
Advisory, as filed. Pruning ignores the file prefix. The default team directory keeps the two stores' backups apart.
Advisory, as filed. Purges run without secure_delete. This is latent while TEAM_LATEST is 1.
Advisory, as filed. renewInstance writes in three transactions. The next start detects the gap and renews again, so it heals itself.
Advisory, as filed (Q4). If publish fails after the push, there is no stated undo for the pushed image. Compose pins an explicit version, so no deployment drifts.
Advisory, as filed (Q1). The two-platform image is pushed without being run. The arm64 image never runs in the pipeline.
Advisory, as filed (Q6). The apt packages are not pinned by version. The base image is pinned by digest.
Advisory, debt outside the change. The profile's health command targets Caddy, not the server.
